BOOK ONE · LESSON 057

An unusual day

不平常的一天

The Sawyers' usual routine is different today. 索耶一家今天的活动与平时不同。

57 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Before reading

Listen then answer this question.

听录音，然后回答问题。索耶先生今晚在做什么？

  1. 1

    It is eight o'clock.

    现在是8点钟。

  2. 2

    The children go to school by car every day, but today, they are going to school on foot.

    孩子们每天都乘小汽车去上学，而今天，他们正步行去上学。

  1. 3

    It is ten o'clock.

    现在是10点钟。

  2. 4

    Mrs. Sawyer usually stays at home in the morning, but this morning, she is going to the shops.

    上午，索耶夫人通常是呆在家里的，但今天上午，她正去商店买东西。

  1. 5

    It is four o'clock.

    现在是4点钟。

  2. 6

    In the afternoon, Mrs. Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living room.

    下午，索耶夫人通常是在客厅里喝茶。

  3. 7

    But this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.

    但今天下午，她正在花园里喝茶。

  1. 8

    It is six o'clock.

    现在是6点钟。

  2. 9

    In the evening, the children usually do their homework, but this evening, they are not doing their homework.

    晚上，孩子们通常是做作业，而今天晚上，他们没做作业。

  3. 10

    At the moment, they are playing in the garden.

    此刻，他们正在花园里玩。

  1. 11

    It is nine o'clock.

    现在是9点钟。

  2. 12

    Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night.

    索耶先生通常是在晚上看报。

  3. 13

    But he's not reading his newspaper tonight.

    但今天晚上他没看报。

  4. 14

    At the moment, he's reading an interesting book.

    此刻，他正在看一本有趣的书。

New words & expressions 生词和短语

o'clock /əˈklɒk/
adv. 点钟
shop /ʃɒp/
n. 商店
moment /ˈməʊmənt/
n. 片刻，瞬间

Notes on the text 课文注释

1 It is eight o'clock.

现在是8点钟。在英语中常用 it 来指时间、天气、温度或距离。这种 it 被称作“虚主语”。

2 by car; on foot

by car, 乘汽车。on foot, 步行。这两个状语短语均用来表示方式。

3 at the moment

at the moment, 指眼前，“此刻”。
